method: Basket v1 is the rand cost of a family Saturday fire as three kilos of meat: 1 kg boerewors, 1 kg bone-in pork loin chops, and 1 kg chicken (braai pack or whole bird). Wood and beer wait for a later basket. Each line is a single confirmed public guest price, never an estimate and never an interpolation. If two stores published a comparable for the same cut, one price enters the basket and the other is listed as a citation — not a ranking. A missing line is a gap. total_zar is the sum of the three lines only when every line is confirmed; otherwise it stays null.
